designationHistory.indexText: Kofa National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1939 for the protection of desert bighorn sheep and other native wildlife following a 1936 campaign by the Arizona Boy Scouts.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
